sanskrit_verse:
यां च रात्रिमजनिष्ठा यां रात्रिं च मरिष्यसि।
वृथा तदन्तरं ते स्यात् कुर्याश्चेत्सत्यमन्यथा॥
transliteration: yāṃ ca rātrim ajanīṣṭhā yāṃ rātriṃ ca mariṣyasi | vṛthā tad antaraṃ te syāt kuryāś cet satyam anyathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That night which you have not lived and that night which you shall not live—if in between you speak falsehood, your existence becomes void.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation is rooted in conscious alignment with sequential time
Capacity-based responsibility arises through truthful inhabitation of temporal moments
Restoration logic demands reintegration of untruthful gaps in experiential continuity
Consciousness alignment requires rectification of speech-time disjunction
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent speaks falsely during temporal interval BETWEEN birth-night AND death-night THEN existence-value = NULL
IF speech-event deviates from truth THEN temporal-integrity-flag = TRUE
IF temporal-integrity-flag = TRUE THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol
IF agent completes truthful reintegration process THEN restore existence-value
NO punitive action SHALL occur; ONLY restoration OF experiential coherence IS enforced
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, this verse establishes that the threshold of responsibility lies in the truthful inhabitation of one's lifespan. Misalignment through false speech creates existential nullity, requiring judicial restoration rather than punitive invalidation. Authority flows from veracity of being across time, not from coercive enforcement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causal misalignment occurs when speech contradicts experiential truth within sequential time. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that each moment builds upon prior integrity. Thus, proportional responsibility lies in restoring lost coherence, not inflicting penalty. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that falsehood dissolves self-authority, necessitating self-renewal, not external judgment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Satyasaṁkalpa Completion Process to realign spoken intent with experiential truth
Deploy Kāla-Saṁskāra Integration Module to heal fractured temporal awareness
Activate Ātma-Vāk Alignment Circuit to ensure future congruence of thought, word, and deed
Assign Svadharmic Rectification Task to regenerate authentic existential value
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Truth governs temporal existence; untruth dissolves it. Only restoration through conscious realignment renews lawful being. Dharma prevails through self-corrective alignment, not punitive consequence. Consciousness itself is the ultimate adjudicator.
